I'm Murali Kummitha (Murali K), a software architect with 12+ years in distributed systems, data engineering and product development. Right now I'm at Intuit, building **agentic systems**: agents that detect drift, upgrades and runtime issues across service libraries, then fix them, notify owners and close the loop. I design these systems around specifications, skill networks and MCP-based tool orchestration, so agents get just the context they need at each step.

Before that I scaled exam platforms, fintech rails and enterprise SaaS. The common thread is systems that have to stay fast and correct when traffic, data or teams grow quickly. I hold a PG Diploma in Machine Learning & AI from IIIT Bangalore.
